article_summary: This article describes a visible light photoredox-catalyzed decarboxylative alkylation of 3-aryl-oxetanes and azetidines. The method generates tertiary benzylic radicals from carboxylic acid precursors, which then undergo Giese addition into electron-deficient alkenes. The study highlights how ring strain and Bent's rule in four-membered heterocycles render the Giese addition irreversible and minimize radical dimerization compared to unstrained benzylic systems.
